name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Nereo Valeriano: model routing for prompts and subagents, a where-am-i card and suggested next steps.

plugins.name: auto-model
plugins.description: Picks the model for each prompt and each subagent (never above /model and /effort for prompts), with Jev, OpenAI or Claude as the picker, and shows a colored bar under the input: model, effort, context, 7-day limit and agents. /auto-model on|off, /route for subagents. Subagent picking is ported from Hamza Zafar's switchboard (MIT).

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt as one card: the goal as its title; now, waiting on you and next with their status; and the next-steps suggestions in the same box. /where for a longer one.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the prompt. In an empty prompt type ; then 1, 2 or 3 to draft one, ;0 to dismiss. A bare digit types as usual.
